subject: Optima Bio - Dedicated capacity: hardware waiver & staged burst plan
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@optimabio.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@optimabio.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — H200 requirement + burst plan

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick summary of what Optima needs for the pilot and a path to production: dedicated pool (initially 8 GPUs), H200 hardware preferred for FP16 model fidelity, and a predictable staged-burst flow for experimental runs. Two specific asks: 

- Can Redwood approve a temporary hardware parity waiver if H200 availability is constrained (i.e., allow H100 or H200-equivalent substitution for up to 30 days while we finalize procurement)?
- We need a reservation hold for 45 days while we finalize payment terms, and a staged-burst structure: 200 burst hours the first month, 150 month two, then 100/month thereafter; we want fixed overage rates and an overage cap negotiated up front.

Our procurement team will need written confirmation of the overage rate and any one-off concessions to present to finance. I attached the requirements doc.

Attachments: Optima_Requirements_20260309.pdf

Appreciate a path forward — timeline is tight (pilot start target: 2026-04-05).

Best,
Samir
Founder & Head of ML Ops
Optima Bio
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@optimabio.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — H200 requirement + burst plan

Samir — thanks for the clear summary and the doc. Looping in Lauren (sales lead) and Karthik (deal desk) to review the hardware waiver and staged-burst plan. Monica from Sales Ops will help draft the formal offer once we have exec signoff.

Short answers for now: we can typically support a temporary hardware substitution, but it requires a signed amendment that limits substitution window and defines fallback SLAs. Reservation holds are doable but require a deposit schedule or confirmed PO to lock capacity. Overage rates can be fixed for the pilot but will need an explicit cap and short-term pricing concession.

Lauren/Karthik — can you take a look at the attached requirements and propose an approvable concession that balances cost exposure and our operational risk? Recommend priority items: substitution duration, staged-burst hours, capped overage, and deposit / PO terms for the 45-day hold.

Rishi
VP, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — H200 requirement + burst plan

Team — reviewed Optima's requirements and the risk profile. Proposed executive concession (for approval and signature):

- Hardware waiver: approve temporary parity waiver allowing H100 substitution for up to 30 days if H200 inventory is constrained. Condition: substitution notice to customer 72 hours prior and auto-revert once H200 is available.
- Reservation hold: grant a 30-day reservation hold with a non-refundable deposit equal to 10% of the first month's committed spend; extendable once with exec review. We will not hold >60 days without signed PO.
- Staged-burst structure: approve 200 hours (month 1) / 150 hours (month 2) / 100 hours (month 3+). Burst hours billed at agreed pilot rate of $9.50/hr; overage beyond bursts billed at $16/hr but capped at 1.5x the committed monthly spend for the pilot term.
- One-off concession: 8% one-time discount on committed monthly tier if Optima signs a 12-month reserved capacity agreement within 45 days of pilot start.
- Conditions: require signed amendment attached to the master agreement, PO or deposit to enable reservation hold, and explicit acknowledgement of substitution policy.

This proposal minimizes operational exposure while giving the customer runway to start the pilot. Karthik/Monica, can you convert this into a short form addendum and pricing sheet? Once ready, Rishi we should send to the customer with DocuSign link and request for PO.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Proposed_MA_Optima_20260310.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@optimabio.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Optima pilot — approved concession and next steps

Samir — good news: executive signoff is in. Summary of what we can commit to for the pilot (see attached short-form addendum and pricing sheet):

- Temporary hardware parity waiver: H100 allowed for up to 30 days if H200 not available; we will notify you 72 hours prior to any substitution.
- Reservation hold: 30-day hold with a 10% non-refundable deposit due to activate the hold. We can extend to 60 days with written exec approval.
- Staged-burst: 200 / 150 / 100 hours for months 1-3; burst billing at $9.50/hr; post-burst overage at $16/hr capped at 1.5x monthly committed spend for the pilot term.
- 8% one-time committed-tier discount if you sign a 12-month reserved contract within 45 days of pilot start.

Next steps: I attached the addendum (Proposed_MA_Optima_20260310.docx) and a DocuSign link for the amendment. Please have procurement return a signed PO or the deposit payment within 10 business days to preserve the reservation hold.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/8923

If you want to hop on a quick call to finalize the PoS we can do a 30-minute slot tomorrow. Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

—Rishi
